tool_args.rationale: The branch probe confirms gradient dependence, so the initial gradient-invariant quartic model is insufficient. Fit quartic flux coefficients plus two low-order gradient-coupling terms numerically; this uses all seven rows and avoids an unnecessary additional probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its two readings establish substantial sink-gradient dependence.
The seven rows contain diverse u_now and two deliberately varied gradients; defer added cost and use the compact verified flux/bridge family.
Does not explain the large response changes at the same general operating regime under altered sink gradients.
The current observations do not uniquely identify a coupled dynamic model; prefer the documented flux form with a parsimonious gradient correction.
